name: databricks-cli
description: A Databricks pane that follows the databricks CLI: browse workspace, Unity Catalog, compute, jobs, pipelines, apps and dashboards, and see what Claude reads or changes.

glyphs.title: Glyphs
glyphs.description: Icon set: auto uses DatabricksSymbols NF when it and a Nerd Font are installed and your terminal started after they were, else Nerd Font, else plain Unicode; Nerd Font over SSH, plain Unicode in the desktop app. Auto detection covers Linux and macOS; on Windows pick one to force it.

follow.title: Follow Claude
follow.description: on: the tree scrolls to what Claude reads, downloads, uploads or changes. off: the view stays where you put it and only your own scrolling moves it; highlights still show.

fontHint.title: Font hint
fontHint.description: on: when auto icons fall back to plain Unicode, Claude is told once per session where to get the fonts. off: no hint.
